tests.description: helm test hooks. Run with `helm test <release> --logs`; never run by install itself.

fullnameOverride.description: Replaces the generated <release>-<name> for this chart's objects. Empty keeps release scoping.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level security context. Everything except `enabled` is passed through verbatim, so any valid Kubernetes PodSecurityContext field may be added.

fsGroup.description: Group ownership applied to mounted volumes so the non-root container can write to them. Required on CSI storage; ignored for hostPath volumes.

containerSecurityContext.description: Container-level security context. Everything except `enabled` is passed through verbatim, so any valid Kubernetes SecurityContext field may be added.

serviceAccountName.description: Default serviceAccountName for this chart's pods, overridden by connectorManagement.serviceAccountName and nifi.serviceAccountName. Empty uses the namespace default. Prefer the per-component values when binding a cloud identity, so the pods do not share one.

proxyServerNoProxyHosts.description: Comma-separated hosts to bypass the proxy for. Only applied when proxyServerHostname is set.

idol-library.description: Helm creates a values entry for every dependency, including the idol-library library chart. It takes no values, but the key must be permitted for additionalProperties: false to work.

documentsecurity.description: Values for the idol-documentsecurity sub-chart. That chart governs the contents; see its values.yaml.

imageRegistry.description: Registry prefix for the bitnami postgresql-ha sub-charts only. Does NOT apply to this chart's own images, which are full references (connectorManagement.image, nifi.image, global.busyboxImage).

busyboxImage.description: busybox image for every init container in this chart and the documentsecurity sub-chart (wait-for-postgres/nifi/documentsecurity, install-seccomp-profile)

defaultStorageClass.description: StorageClass for every PVC this chart and its sub-charts create. A per-volume storageClass overrides it. Empty leaves the cluster default to apply; "-" disables dynamic provisioning.

imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets used to pull container images. May be empty or omitted when the registry needs no credentials, or when they are supplied by the node or the pods' ServiceAccount.

imagePullPolicy.description: Pull policy for every container in this chart and its sub-charts. A per-component imagePullPolicy overrides it. Empty means IfNotPresent.
Pull policy for this component's image. Empty inherits global.imagePullPolicy.

serviceAccountName.description: serviceAccountName for this component's pod. Empty inherits the chart-wide serviceAccountName.

reconcileOnStartup.description: On startup, redeploy connectors and targets this release deployed that NiFi no longer has.

shutdownDrainSeconds.description: How long the api waits on shutdown for requests in flight to finish. terminationGracePeriodSeconds is derived from it.

jvmHeapInitPercentage.description: API JVM initial heap as a percentage of resources.limits.memory (-XX:InitialRAMPercentage). Must not exceed jvmHeapMaxPercentage. A numeric string is accepted, since --set passes a decimal as a string.

jvmHeapMaxPercentage.description: API JVM maximum heap as a percentage of resources.limits.memory (-XX:MaxRAMPercentage). A numeric string is accepted, since --set passes a decimal as a string.

secretEnv.description: Sensitive env vars for the api, rendered into a Secret instead of the ConfigMap.

callbacksEndpoint.description: Base URL NiFi uses to call back into the internal API. Empty defaults to http://<release-scoped service name>:8081.

reportsCallbackUrl.description: Optional URL to POST reports to. Empty disables report callbacks.

auth.description: JWT authentication for the public API. Disabled by default, which leaves /v1/** unauthenticated.

jwksUri.description: OTDS JWKS URI used to validate tokens. Required when enabled is true.

issuer.description: Issuer a token must name. Required when enabled is true.

audience.description: Audience a token must be addressed to. Required when enabled is true, unless requireValidSubscription is true.

etsUrl.description: Entitlement Service URL for subscription and role lookup. When set, roles come from the caller's ETS subscription rather than the token's scopes. Optional unless requireValidSubscription is true.

etsCacheTtl.description: How long a user's ETS entitlement is reused, e.g. 60s. 0 looks it up on every request.

requireValidSubscription.description: Refuse a caller unless the subscription it acts as is to one of validSubscriptionApplications.

validSubscriptionApplications.description: Application names a subscription must be to. Required when requireValidSubscription is true.

startupProbe.description: Startup gate on /v1/health/live. failureThreshold x periodSeconds is the budget before the kubelet kills the container; raise it for a first boot with the seeded storage provider.

metrics.description: Prometheus metrics on the internal port (/internal/metrics, 8081). Cross-tenant aggregates - must not be routed through the public ingress.

serviceMonitor.description: Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor. Requires the monitoring.coreos.com CRDs.

port_number.description: A port, as a string or an integer. Both are accepted because `--set foo.port=8443` yields an integer while `--set-string` yields a string, and rejecting one of them is a needless papercut. The pattern constrains strings; minimum/maximum constrain integers.

existingClaim.description: Name of an existing, already-populated PVC to mount instead of provisioning one. When set, storageClass/size/accessModes are ignored and no PVC is created.

readOnly.description: Mount the volume read-only. Must be false when the volume is the target of the seeded storage provider.

SeccompProfile.description: Kubernetes seccomp profile. Localhost also requires localhostProfile, and the file must be present on the node.

localhostProfile.description: Path relative to the kubelet seccomp root. Required when type is Localhost.

CacheVolume.description: emptyDir backing the storage-provider cache, mounted at the path named by env.CONNECTORS_STORAGE_PROVIDER_CACHE_DIR. No volume is created when that env var is unset.

sizeLimit.description: Optional cap on the emptyDir, e.g. 10Gi. Empty means uncapped.

existingSecret.description: Secret you manage holding the NiFi API credentials. Rotating a value inside it does not restart the api - the chart cannot read it.

existingSecretUsernameKey.description: Key in existingSecret holding the username. Empty keeps using the username value.

existingSecretPasswordKey.description: Key in existingSecret holding the password.

NifiTls.description: Certificate verification for an https:// NiFi endpoint. Off by default, which accepts any certificate from any issuer.

verifyHostname.description: Check the certificate names the host in endpoint. Only consulted when verify is on.

existingCaSecret.description: Secret holding the certificate to trust. Empty uses the JVM default trust store.

existingCaConfigMap.description: ConfigMap holding the certificate to trust, as an alternative to existingCaSecret.

caKey.description: Key within the Secret/ConfigMap. A .p12, .pfx or .jks extension is read as a trust store, anything else as PEM.

trustStorePassword.description: Password for the trust store named by caKey. Ignored for PEM.

existingTrustStorePasswordSecret.description: Secret holding the trust store password, instead of trustStorePassword.

name.description: Display name for the pipeline target

Postgresql.description: The bundled postgresql-ha sub-chart (enabled: true), or the credential/connection settings shared with an existing instance described by externalPostgresql (enabled: false). Sub-chart values are not constrained here.

enabled.description: Whether to deploy the bundled postgresql-ha sub-chart

existingSecret.description: Secret you manage holding the bundled database's credentials (keys: password, repmgr-password, admin-password). Must also be passed to postgresql.postgresql.existingSecret and postgresql.pgpool.existingSecret. Required for GitOps, where lookup-based generation would rotate on every sync. For an external instance use externalPostgresql.existingSecret.

jdbcParameters.description: Optional JDBC query parameters appended to the connection URL, e.g. sslmode=require

Sub-Chart.description: The bundled sub-chart (enabled: true). Sub-chart values are not constrained here.

enabled.description: Whether to deploy the bundled sub-chart
Whether to deploy the NiFi instance

name.description: Component name for the NiFi StatefulSet, Service and DNS; objects are named <release>-<name>

fullnameOverride.description: Replaces the generated <release>-<name> for the NiFi objects. Empty keeps release scoping.

imagePullPolicy.description: Pull policy for this component's image. Empty inherits global.imagePullPolicy.

serviceAccountName.description: serviceAccountName for this component's pod. Empty inherits the chart-wide serviceAccountName.

sensitivePropsKey.description: Key NiFi uses to encrypt sensitive properties. Empty generates a 32-character key on first install and preserves it; a supplied value must be at least 12 characters (NiFi's own minimum).

existingSensitivePropsSecret.description: Secret you manage holding the sensitive properties key under key `sensitive-props-key`.

jvmHeapInitPercentage.description: JVM initial heap as a percentage of resources.limits.memory (-XX:InitialRAMPercentage). Must not exceed jvmHeapMaxPercentage. A numeric string is accepted, since --set passes a decimal as a string.

jvmHeapMaxPercentage.description: JVM maximum heap as a percentage of resources.limits.memory (-XX:MaxRAMPercentage). A numeric string is accepted, since --set passes a decimal as a string.

env.description: Environment variables for the NiFi container, e.g. DOCSECURITY_API_URL which the UserSecurity flow resolves.

devShmSize.description: Size of the /dev/shm Memory-medium emptyDir. The Web connector's headless Chrome aborts rather than degrading when a shared-memory allocation fails, and the 64MB runtime default is not enough. Keep resources.limits.memory comfortably above the maximum heap (jvmHeapMaxPercentage of it) plus this.

seccompInstaller.description: Installs a Localhost seccomp profile onto the node via a one-shot root initContainer with a hostPath write. Needs a namespace permitting hostPath and a root pod - PodSecurity baseline or privileged, not restricted.

kubeletSeccompDir.description: Kubelet seccomp root on the node; localhostProfile is resolved relative to this.

enabled.description: Advertise NiFi's Prometheus metrics with prometheus.io/* pod annotations

ExternalPostgresql.description: An existing PostgreSQL instance this chart does not deploy. Used only when postgresql.enabled is false; ignored when the bundled sub-chart is deployed.

host.description: Hostname of the existing PostgreSQL instance (or a Service pointing at one). Required when postgresql.enabled is false.

port.description: Port of the existing PostgreSQL instance.

database.description: Database on the existing instance. Falls back to postgresql.postgresql.database.

username.description: User on the existing instance. Falls back to postgresql.postgresql.username.

password.description: Password on the existing instance. Falls back to postgresql.postgresql.password.

existingSecret.description: Secret you manage holding this instance's credentials (a password, and optionally a username). Separate from postgresql.existingSecret, which is for the bundled database and must carry bitnami's key names.

existingSecretPasswordKey.description: Which key of postgresql.existingSecret holds the password. External instance only - the bundled sub-chart requires "password".

existingSecretUsernameKey.description: Which key of postgresql.existingSecret holds the username. External instance only; empty takes the username from values.
